sources.title: Named Entity Recognition with Fine-Tuned BERT - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository hosts a Named Entity Recognition (NER) application powered by a fine-tuned BERT model. The model has been trained on the CoNLL-2003 dataset, which is a widely used dataset for NER tasks, containing annotations for entities like persons, locations, organizations.
